question: How is the constant washing of the mouth symbolically identified in this teaching?
premises: Washing of the mouth is performed always.
It is described as having gone upward.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is identified as an upward movement of Brahman.
uncertainties: The symbolic or ritual meaning of this identification is terse and context-dependent.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is the upward movement of Brahman.
